name: okr-doing-agent
description: Install a local OKR Doing system, inventory old OKR assets from local folders and Yinxiang/Evernote sources, and guide migration safely.

interface.shortDescription: Install OKR OS, inventory old assets, and migrate safely.
interface.longDescription: OKR Doing Agent provides three user-facing services: OKR 系统安装 for setting up a personal Logseq OKR Doing system, OKR 资产盘点 for local old OKR folders plus Yinxiang/Evernote content.enml, HTML, .resources, and .notes sources, and OKR 资产迁移 for guided migration/fusion from the asset map into the new system with preview and explicit confirmation.
interface.defaultPrompt: 用 OKR Doing Agent 帮我做 OKR 系统安装、OKR 资产盘点，或 OKR 资产迁移。
